answer: Pulse-Synchronized Coordination Windows.** Each agent may join a coordination round only inside a randomly assigned micro-window; the network broadcasts a global pulse every few seconds, and an identity's slot is derived from its registration block hash. To saturate many windows an attacker must hold identities spread across the full pulse cycle, and each one costs a fixed marble-sized registration fee plus a per-window heartbeat proof that must be submitted live.
